reason: Factorization measurements only: DensePoly.natPow changes executable behavior at exponent one, returning p and skipping the unused final square. The saved warm hexbz_factor_service --entry factor observations cannot reach that body. Entry.run dispatches to ZPoly.factorize/factorTraced/runFactor and factorizationOfFactors; multiplicity expansion uses unchanged Factorization.polyPow, and modular factorization uses unchanged finite-field power kernels. A scan of current generated C covers direct natPow calls and the instNPow/instGrindSemiringDensePoly/instGrindRingDensePoly/instGrindCommRingDensePoly function objects that could call it indirectly. No factor-service dependency or caller uses those instances: this includes all FACTOR_LIBRARIES (in particular determinant, GramSchmidt, Bareiss, RowReduce, Modular and TruncatedSeries), HexPoly other than Instances, the umbrella imports and both bench drivers. The determinant carrier matches are conformance modules outside the service dependency closure. This is a reachability claim for the warm factor-service entry, not global runtime neutrality. Only factor_family currently reads this exemption directory; this entry must not be inherited by BKR, sign-determination or any new measurement family without adding explicit family scoping.
